properties.label: Copy and exploded-document split
properties.text: Balance a left copy column with a large dimetric exploded document on the right, preserving a shared perspective, external guides and clear air between five parallel sheets.

properties.label: Charcoal with green reading accent
properties.text: Use charcoal #1a1a1c, near-white linework and one minimal green reading accent.

properties.label: Exploded decision-ledger sheets
properties.text: Draw five planes with visible edges, subtle face values and real miniature decision-ledger content, using a consistent line hierarchy from outer silhouette to document structure to annotations.

properties.label: Registered sheet inspection
properties.text: The object may remain still; any inspection movement must preserve registration between all sheets.

properties.label: Selectable main-column copy
properties.text: Keep the text in the main copy column as real selectable DOM text.

properties.label: Projection integrity acceptance
properties.text: Do not substitute arbitrary rotated rectangles. On mobile retain the complete projection, its outer leaders and the relationship between plane spacing and object width.
